title: Meet export conditions before exporting regulated waste material
what: Regulated waste material may be exported only if prescribed export conditions are complied with.

sources.title: Recycling and Waste Reduction Act 2020
sources.quote: 20 Exporting regulated waste material—non-compliance with prescribed export conditions (1) A person contravenes this subsection if: (a) the person exports waste material; and (b) the waste material is regulated waste material; and (c) the export of the waste material is prohibited unless prescribed export conditions are complied with; and (d) prescribed export conditions are not complied with. Fault-based offence
